body: This 2025 Sprinter AWD 170 in our El Capitan Tier is built for travelers who want comfort, storage, and capability in one clean setup. It features a king bed, 800Ah Battle Born power system, 33 gallon water tank, roof A/C, diesel heat, full kitchen, outdoor shower setup, weBoost connectivity, and a rugged exterior package with upgraded suspension, recovery gear, extra fuel capacity, and rear storage.
